correctness.rationale: The exact identity 2S_n=B_k Q_(4n+2k)-k follows from the Pell doubling identity and a finite geometric sum; the differences are 4B_k P_(4n+2k+2). Strong divisibility reduces the infinite GCD exactly to gcd(S_0,8B_k) for even k and gcd(S_0,48B_k) for odd k. At all odd primes except 3 valuations equal those of gcd(B_k,k); prime 3 is one additional factor exactly for odd multiples of 3. For even k=2^t u the Pell duplication and mod-4 congruences show v_2(S_0)=t, matching gcd(B_k,k). Thus every prime valuation is independently determined for every integer k>=1. The packaged checker corroborates 8,000 exact window identities and 320 parameters; finite checks are not the proof.

value.rationale: The invariant was singled out in a published explicit open problem. The result determines the infinite Lucas-cobalancing square-window GCD at every k, proves its exceptional factor precisely at odd multiples of three, and provides a structural explanation by Pell strong divisibility and local prime-three arithmetic. It is not an arbitrary finite slice or a mere recomputation, though it leaves gcd(B_k,k) unsimplified.
